description: A dark oil painting of a thin, bare-chested man in a loincloth standing in a column of flames on a pyre, head tilted back, with a charred stake above his head and smoke billowing behind. An old white-bearded man in a black robe holds an open book on the left, and a crowd in dark 16th-17th century clothing watches from both sides in a cobbled square at night. The painting does not reach the image edges: a clean white margin of uniform width surrounds it on all four sides, like a mat, and a small sparkle mark sits in the bottom right corner.
reason: the painting sits inside a wide white mat or border on all four sides; it should fill the image edge to edge.
